tasks.short: Take attendance and maintain the class attendance record

steps.what: Open and verify the current class roster and attendance date
Take class attendance by checking which students are physically present
Enter observed attendance directly in the existing class attendance register
Resolve uncertain attendance and correct late arrivals in the register
inputs: verified late arrivals or absence information

tasks.design: Open the current class register in {LMS} and record actual presence there, replacing a paper list followed by re-entry where that duplicate workflow exists. Keep physical attendance checks and exception reconciliation human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Copying a temporary attendance list into the official register duplicates capture.
tasks.enabler_now: A native class attendance screen can accept the observation at its source.
tasks.still_hard: Late arrivals, mistaken identity and unclear absences require verification.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm who is actually present rather than infer presence from a device.
tasks.altitude: Capture attendance once in the existing register.

reach.learn: Keep unresolved status distinct from confirmed absence

evidence.claim: ParnasSys offers pupil administration; direct attendance capture and local duplicate-entry savings require confirmation.

assumptions: The attendance register is explicitly required and already used by the school. The central case assumes a paper observation list is currently copied into it; already direct capture has no re-entry saving.

The assistant verifies class, date and pupil identifiers in s1, observes presence in s2 and produces each attendance status in s3. The retained 17.5 recording hours include first capture and ordinary saves; no pre-existing structured present flag is assumed.

The current-class view removes 2 of 10 roster-navigation hours. Direct entry removes 17.5 of 35 recording hours by eliminating the second copy, not the initial observation or exceptions. Offline capture falls back to the current paper route.
No automatic absence message or second-system transfer is implied. Ordinary author saves and corrections need no self-approval.
unknowns: Whether attendance is already captured directly
research_questions: Does direct register capture eliminate a real second copy after accounting for offline fallback?

already_counted.description: Capture actual attendance and reconcile uncertain cases

incremental.description: Maintain the class attendance view and access

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=80.5, gross 19.5 less 1 upkeep gives 18.5 net. Already direct capture retaining all 35 recording hours and nine roster hours has its one-hour navigation saving offset by upkeep. With intermittent offline use retaining 22 recording and nine roster hours plus other 55 and 1 upkeep, net is 13. Physical presence checks and exception handling remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in parent conferences about pupil progress and problems

steps.what: Review relevant students' work and the teacher's conference focus
Participate in the teacher-parent conference about progress and problems
outputs: shared observations and discussed next support

steps.what: Write the assistant's agreed support actions in the existing pupil conference note
inputs: shared observations and discussed next support

tasks.design: Use existing pupil-work links in {LMS} and the current conference-note action fields. Retain the assistant's conference participation and separately capture the actions the assistant must perform.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding relevant work and recreating action-note context repeats handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native pupil links and existing action fields can remove these operations.
tasks.still_hard: The family discussion and interpretation of difficulties require human understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Contribute concrete observations without exceeding the teacher's responsibility.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated preparation and action-note context.

reach.learn: Make each assistant action specific without duplicating the full conference record

evidence.claim: ParnasSys supports pupil records and support plans; the proposed conference preparation and action-field savings remain local E1 estimates.

assumptions: The assistant already captures their assigned support actions in the shared pupil note used for follow-up. No duplicate transcript or full meeting minutes is added.

The assistant verifies pupil work, conference focus and disclosure scope in s1, obtains actual support actions in s2 and captures them in s3. Capture and checking are counted; uncertain assignments are clarified with the teacher manually.
Work links remove 3 of 15 preparation hours. Stable pupil and action headings remove 1.5 of 15 writing hours; substantive action text remains human.
Ordinary same-system author saves remain included without approval. No external follow-up send is implied.
unknowns: Whether assistants already use a shared action note
research_questions: Does existing note reuse reduce work without duplicating the teacher's conference record?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual assistant support actions

incremental.description: Maintain current pupil links and action headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact pupil observations and support contribution disclosed to verified conference participants within permitted scope; changed participants or content require reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=95.5, gross 4.5 less 0.5 upkeep gives 4 net. Incompatible pupil-work links retaining all preparation and 14.5 writing hours have their saving offset by upkeep. Usable links retaining 13 preparation and 14 writing hours plus 70 conference and 0.5 upkeep yield 2.5 net. Conference participation remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assist children with safe bus loading and unloading

steps.what: Check the bus position, boarding area and children needing immediate assistance
Assist students physically and verbally during bus loading and unloading
Confirm children have cleared the boarding area and completed the immediate handover
steps.handoff_to: bus driver or receiving school staff

tasks.design: Retain physical boarding checks, assistance and confirmation of the transition. A checklist in {DOCS} cannot perform these physical actions; no boarding log or device-based presence claim is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on physical presence and immediate hazard recognition.
tasks.enabler_now: No identified software operation removes safe boarding assistance.
tasks.still_hard: Children and traffic move unpredictably around the vehicle.
tasks.human_edge: See hazards and give immediate practical help.

reach.learn: Use clear responsibility at the transition

evidence.claim: Physical boarding assistance and immediate safety checks remain human without an identified record operation to remove.

assumptions: The task is assistance at the bus, not route planning or maintaining a passenger register. No routine written record is identified or added.
The assistant produces condition and presence observations in s1-s3, with all observation and confirmation time retained. No machine consumes an assumed boarded flag.

No native view, document template or till setting removes the priced physical assistance. If a school already requires a passenger check record, that operation must be measured rather than inferred here.
No system or recurring upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Whether local procedure includes a separate required passenger-record operation
research_questions: Does observation of the current boarding process identify any actual lookup or record write?

already_counted.description: Check physical conditions and confirm the immediate transition

approvals.approved_version: Exact assistance and directions delivered to the present children under current boarding conditions; changes require immediate assistant judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=100 and no upkeep gives zero. Routine boarding and cases needing extra assistance both retain physical checks, hands-on support and transition confirmation; no identified repeated data operation is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Grade work, compute totals and record checked results

steps.what: Prepare homework and test responses, answer keys and pupil identifiers for marking
Grade closed questions against the verified answer key
Grade open responses using the teacher's rubric and check each proposed judgement

loop.purpose: Propose rubric-linked scores for open responses
loop.input: Verified response text and teacher's applicable rubric
loop.output: Proposed score with cited response evidence for each criterion
loop.check: Assistant reads every response and checks score and evidence against the rubric within delegated marking authority
loop.stop: One correction; ambiguous or unsupported scores are marked manually or referred through the existing teacher route
loop.why_not_simpler: Open-response meaning is not captured by a fixed answer key

steps.what: Compute result totals using the verified scoring weights
Check computed results, pupil mapping and the exact result batch to record
outputs: checked result batch and target mapping

steps.what: Record the checked result batch in the separate pupil records system
inputs: checked result batch and target mapping

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the assessment platform, for answer-key marking, bounded open-response proposals and weighted totals. The assistant checks the exact result batch and pupil mapping before a separate transfer replaces real re-keying into {LMS}; unsupported formats retain manual marking and entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual fixed-key marking, totals and second-system result entry repeat structured work.
tasks.enabler_now: Assessment rules, rubric proposals and checked result exports can assist each distinct operation.
tasks.still_hard: Open-response meaning, incomplete answers and incorrect pupil mapping need human review.
tasks.human_edge: Judge each open answer fairly and resolve ambiguous results within delegated authority.
tasks.altitude: Reduce mechanical marking and transfer while retaining accountable result checking.

reach.learn: Distinguish rule-marked items from reviewed open responses

evidence.claim: Ans supports closed-question marking, open-answer marker allocation and item analysis.
The Michigan feedback trial reported acceptance of 88% of proposed rubric judgements but did not measure time savings.

assumptions: The central case includes manual closed-item marking, manual totals and a real re-key from the assessment platform into a separate pupil record. Existing automated marking or a same-system save provides none of that claimed saving.

The assistant verifies pupil and item identifiers, key version, rubric and weights in s1, capturing any paper responses manually within 12 retained preparation hours. No unpriced OCR or structured answer feed is assumed; unsupported scripts stay manual.

Native assessment input layouts remove 3 of 15 preparation hours through stable item and identity structure. s3 retains 17.5 hours for every-answer review and correction. s5 verifies final scores and exact target fields before transfer.

s6 transfers only the checked batch; changed scores, pupil mapping or target invalidate its gate. No pupil publication or parent notification is implied. Ordinary same-system author saves offer no saving.
unknowns: Whether marking and totals are already automated
Existence of a genuine second-system re-key
research_questions: Does the full workflow save time after paper capture, every-answer review, mapping checks and transfer exceptions?

already_counted.description: Check open responses and the exact result batch and mapping

incremental.description: Maintain keys, rubric proposal checks and result transfer mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact scores, pupil identifiers, assessment identifier, target fields and batch version checked in s5; any change invalidates transfer permission

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=44.5, gross 55.5 less 4 upkeep gives 51.5 net. Conservative case: fixed-key marking and totals already run natively, records share the same system, and open-response checking retains 23 of 25 hours; two preparation hours plus two marking hours removed are offset by four upkeep, yielding zero. A compatible mixed-paper workflow retaining 14 preparation, 5 closed-marking exception, 20 open-marking, 2 total-check, 15 final-review and 5 transfer-exception hours plus 4 upkeep yields 35 net. Every structured input's capture and every transfer check remain counted.

role.altitude: Capture required records once and retain personal conference participation and physical student support.
reach: Provide checked assessment results to teachers
skills_to_grow: Check rubric proposals against actual answers
Verify final result batches and pupil mapping
role.ambitious_version: An assistant with less repeated attendance and result entry who remains engaged with children, families and the responsible teacher.
